name: Pumpkin Head

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

languages: Understands Common plus one other language, but only speaks using Mimicry

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.summary: Speaks only in the voice of the person it replaced, or of anyone it used Personality Consumption on; a DC 14 Wis (Insight) check spots it.
traits.text: The pumpkin head can imitate the voice of the person it replaced, or of anyone it has used Personality Consumption on. A listener tells it is an imitation only by succeeding on a DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

traits.name: Sorrowful Memento
traits.summary: Disadvantage on D20 Tests while it can see a creature holding a possession of the person it replaced.
traits.text: If the pumpkin head can see a creature holding something that belonged to the person it replaced, it makes D20 Tests with Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: One Claw and one Pitchfork attack, and Personality Consumption if it is available.

actions.name: Pitchfork
actions.summary: +5, reach 10 ft, 1d8+3 Piercing; it can pull (or push) a Medium or smaller target 5 ft.
actions.text: On a hit against a Medium or smaller creature the pumpkin head may push it 5 feet or pull it 5 feet. (Entered as a pull; the push choice is not modelled.)

actions.name: Personality Consumption
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. One creature it can see within 30 ft, DC 12 Int save: Stunned until the end of its next turn and Intelligence drops by 1d4 (0 kills it); a slain Humanoid becomes a new Pumpkin Head 1d8 hours later unless the body is burned.

summary: A fiend-animated scarecrow wearing a stolen face and voice: it claws, hooks victims in with a pitchfork and eats minds, replacing the slain with copies of itself.
